english: Let $S$ be the set of all three-digit numbers whose digits are distinct, belong to $\{1,2,3,4,5,6,7\}$ and are in strictly increasing order from left to right. Then the arithmetic mean of the elements of $S$ is ______.
hindi: माना कि $S$ उन सभी तीन अंकीय संख्याओं का समुच्चय है जिनके अंक भिन्न हैं, $\{1,2,3,4,5,6,7\}$ में से हैं तथा बाएँ से दाएँ निरन्तर वर्धमान क्रम में हैं। तब $S$ के अवयवों का समान्तर माध्य ______ है।
solution: Each 3-subset of $\{1,\ldots,7\}$ gives exactly one number, so $|S|=\binom{7}{3}=35$; the digits are min, middle, max
solution_full: A number in $S$ is determined by its set of digits, written in increasing order, so $|S|=\binom{7}{3}=35$, and its digits are the smallest, middle and largest element of a 3-subset.
Hundreds digit $a$: the other two digits are chosen from $\{a+1,\ldots,7\}$, so $a$ occurs $\binom{7-a}{2}$ times. Sum $=1\cdot15+2\cdot10+3\cdot6+4\cdot3+5\cdot1=70$.
Tens digit $b$: one smaller digit from $b-1$ choices and one larger from $7-b$, so $b$ occurs $(b-1)(7-b)$ times. Sum $=2\cdot5+3\cdot8+4\cdot9+5\cdot8+6\cdot5=10+24+36+40+30=140$.
Units digit $c$: the other two from $\{1,\ldots,c-1\}$, so $c$ occurs $\binom{c-1}{2}$ times. Sum $=3\cdot1+4\cdot3+5\cdot6+6\cdot10+7\cdot15=210$.

Mean $=\dfrac{8610}{35}=246$. (Equivalently, the average smallest, middle and largest digits are $2,4,6$, giving $246$; the reflection $d\mapsto8-d$ shows the average of the smallest and largest digits is 4.)
originality_note: New: the mean of numbers whose digits are a 3-subset in increasing order, which needs the position-wise digit sums computed through order statistics of subsets (way 5: forming numbers and summing them, linked through how often a digit is the minimum, middle or maximum). Closest known: 'sum of all numbers formed by permuting given digits' ((n-1)! x digit sum x 111...1). Different because: each digit appears in a position a number of times that depends on the digit, so the permutation symmetry is lost.
blueprint_concepts: Formation of numbers with given digits (repetition allowed / not)
Sum of all numbers formed from given digits

concept_use.Formation of numbers with given digits (: Each number is formed from a 3-subset of {1,...,7} with no repetition and a forced order, so |S| = C(7,3) = 35.
concept_use.Sum of all numbers formed from given dig: The sum of all numbers is computed place by place from how often each digit occupies each place, then divided by 35.

stem_review: Read as a student: every symbol and object is defined before use, every condition is stated, each sentence has one reading; the answer was recomputed by an independent brute-force enumeration in Python (sympy/itertools), is unique and matches the Answer Plan. Checked by listing all 35 numbers (sum 8610), that 'strictly increasing' excludes repeated digits, and that 246 is a positive 3-digit integer as planned. Changed: No change.
key_step: Counting how often each digit is the hundreds, tens and units digit of an increasing triple.
justification: The usual permutation-sum shortcut fails; the student must count by position with order statistics, a two-idea chain with a numerical answer. Level 3, comparable to 2026-P1-Q11 (L3).
